observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for a Canon EOS M50 camera kit.
The box text indicates it includes an EF-M 15-45mm IS STM lens.
Icons on the box suggest 24.1 Megapixels, Dual Pixel CMOS AF, 4K video, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth connectivity.
A watermark 'BLESSED MOSES STORE' is overlaid on the image.
The actual camera body, lens, and accessories are not visible outside the box.

claims.evidence: The box mentions it, but the lens itself is not shown.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual camera and lens outside of the box.

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have a high shutter count.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and a screenshot of the shutter count.

risks.risk: The lens or sensor may have scratches, dust, or fungus.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the camera sensor and both ends of the lens glass.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual camera body and lens out of the box from multiple angles.
A photo of the camera screen powered on.
Photos of the lens glass (front and back) and the camera sensor.
A photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap).
response.reason: Only the retail box is shown. Without photos of the actual camera and lens, their existence and physical condition cannot be verified.
